Free functionality is useless. This developer’s monetization strategy is ridiculous. You download this free app and are immediately pushed to buy a subscription for $9.99/month before even getting to try any functionality. That’s right, $9.99/month, not just $9.99. You can skip this (it’s not obvious how, but look for the “Later” button) to try the tuner. However, in the free version the accuracy is limited and it does not give you fine tuning numbers when you get near the correct pitch. I just keeps popping up annoying messages like “E2 Perfect!” even when you’re quite far off. You can tune better by ear.
Then there are surprise full-screen ads for soliatre games that pop up and are impossible to close. I had to quit the app to get rid of them.
If the developer would just charge $2.99 up front for full accuracy they’d have a nice product. Instead they are dishonest about their product and lose out on customers as a result.
